import html def generate_html_response(user_content: str) -> str: """ Generate an HTML page by embedding the provided user content into a template. Parameters ---------- user_content : str The raw content supplied by the user that will be inserted into the page. Returns ------- str A complete HTML document with the user content safely escaped. """ # Basic HTML template with a placeholder for user content html_template = """ User Content Page

Your Content

{user_content}
""" # Escape the user content to prevent XSS attacks safe_content = html.escape(user_content) # Insert the escaped content into the template return html_template.format(user_content=safe_content)
